programme.title: Kapernaum

programme.title: The 51st State

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: I en tidløs, mytisk skog er Jack utvalgt av skjebnen tilå redde den nydelige Prinsesse Lili og beseire dendemoniske Mørkets Fyrste. Hvis ikke kastes verden ut ievigvarende istid. Med Tom Cruise, Mia Sara og Tim Curry.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt

programme.title: Midnight in Paris

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programme.desc: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins

programme.title: The Monster Squad

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Da Jack Deebs satt i fengsel skapte han Cool World, en tegneserie om hespetreet Holli Would. Men blod er tynnere enn blekk når Holli tar menneskelig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Mutant X: No Man Left Behind

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Dagger of Death

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Last of the Mochicas

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fertile Ground

programme.title: Snowden

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: advarsel: denne helt nye filmen inkluderer helt nytt innhold som er uklippet, skandaløst og fullstendig upassende! Bad Grandpa .5 gir deg et helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans verden med utrolige bonusscener og morsomme skøyerstreker.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jacques er eier av en hardbarket bar i New York som fungerer som et slags hjem for et broket utvalg av profesjonelle drankere. Jacques prøver målbevisst å drikke og røyke seg til døde når han møter Lucas, en hjemløs, ung mann som allerede har gitt opp…

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programme.desc: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programme.desc: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
programme.desc: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: Vår, sommer, høst, vinter... og vår
programme.desc: I en flytende eneboerhytte i vill koreansk natur blir en gutt veiledet gjennom livets faser av en gammel munk. Men når gutten møter kjærlighet, begjær og vold, settes alt på spill. En poetisk fortelling om visdom, prøvelser og livets evige kretsløp.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: In their makeshift laboratory, three boys use an amazing discovery and their ingenuity to build their own spaceship and launch themselves on a fantastic interplanetary journey.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney mottar et kort sjeldne Tarot-kort fra sin nylig avdøde venn. Den beryktede, tidligere nevnte Gribben var etter ham. Sydney verver Claudia til å hjelpe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: Andromeda har til oppgave å eskortere medisinske skip trygt gjennom Drago-Kazov-rommet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hjemmebranner

programme.title: Andromeda: Inn i labyrinten
programme.desc: En avgrunnsagent prøver å lokke Harper til å bli med i Magog

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Når de redder en ung prins fra et opprør som dreper resten av familien hans, blir Dylan og Tyr bedt om å være hans rådgivere.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home

Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom

Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13

All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less

His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy

programme.title: Darkman

Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: The Thing

A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

She is suspected of delivering money to a terrorist, Jackson Tsui (Jackson Liu), who is trying to obtain a nuclear warhead from the Russian mob. Traveling from Hong Kong to Ukraine to Australia, Chan aims to bust up the terrorist plot using his fists as much as his brains, doing battle underwater, on stilts and across mountain tops.

After Diamond Dallas Page (Diamond Dallas Page) dethrones their hero, Gordie and Sean embark on a mission to help King get his title back. When they finally track him down, however, they discover that King is not too keen on recapturing his former glory. Can the boys find a way to motivate the faded champ?

When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him?

Shep attempts to acclimate himself -- he skateboards, he accosts a mail carrier -- but he's destined to be a fish out of water. But when his outer space enemies arrive and pick a fight with his new friends, Shep is ready to prove his mettle.

After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

When criminal Tommy Thanatos (David Johansen) kidnaps the kids to get his hands on a new computer chip, Sean must rescue them.

Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.title: Tiny House Eviction
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 172
programme.desc: Miguel encuentra a Gastón en la casa de Angelita. Teo defiende a José de Gastón. Carlo se va a Nueva York sin Alma y al despedirse de Roberta le deja unas cartas. Diego casi muere, porque los frenos de su coche fueron cortados a propósito.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 173
programme.desc: Nico le ruega a Lupita que les invente a sus padres que es judía. Miguel le pide dinero prestado a Mía. Facundo le dice a Roberta que descompuso el carro de Diego. Vico y Giovanni se quedan encerrados en la cafetería. Diego finge que pierde la memoria.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 174
programme.desc: Diego le regala flores y le roba un beso a Roberta, ella cree que Diego ha cambiado. Alma propone que Mía y Roberta celebren su cumpleaños juntas. Miguel y Luján hacen un plan contra la señora que se hizo pasar por la tía de Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 175
programme.desc: Roberta le dice a Diego que acepta ser su novia. Franco le pregunta a Alma si le está ayudando a Mía con la fiesta de cumpleaños. Miguel y Gastón se pelean a golpes.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 176
programme.desc: Alma organiza la fiesta de cumpleaños de Mía y Roberta. Diego y Roberta son secuestrados por León. Miguel y Mía descubren el secreto de Gastón. Simón es el nuevo fotógrafo de Alma para la fiesta de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 177
programme.desc: Simón se convierte en el fotógrafo oficial de la fiesta de Roberta y Mía, Roberta se niega. Giovanni se reincorpora a la escuela. La banda va a tocar a un café y Tomás canta con otro grupo. Teo y José se besan.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 178
programme.desc: Mía cena con su padre y Valeria, quién tiene un plan para arruinar la fiesta. Alma descubre que Roberta y Diego son novios. Vico visita a la mamá de Giovanni. Celina cree que Simón siente algo por ella.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 179
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse de viaje en su cumpleaños con su papá. Franco le prohíbe a Mía seguir viendo a Alma, pues es mala influencia. Pilar amenaza a Diego con decirle de la apuesta a Roberta si no le ayuda a ser novia de Tomás.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 180
programme.desc: Simón es el nuevo fotógrafo de la escuela y se enamora de Roberta. Eugenia visita a José para platicarle sobre su tutor. Alma tiene un plan para que Mía no se vaya de viaje con Franco. Roberta hace un trato con Simón para salvarse del examen de Inglés.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 181
programme.desc: Miguel planea descubrir si Gastón es millonario. Tomás le explica a Roberta que Diego no la deja por lastima. Alma abofetea a Diego por herir a Roberta. Mía cuestiona a Gastón. Mayra motiva a Giovanni para que le diga a Vico que le gusta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 182
programme.desc: Gastón le dice a Franco que está saliendo con Mía. Simón sigue a Roberta hasta su casa de campo. Giovanni le pide perdón a Vico. Pascual les informa a los alumnos que Giovanni fue aceptado nuevamente en el colegio. Renata investiga a Madariaga.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 183
programme.desc: Giovanni presenta a sus padres frente a todos sus compañeros y les pide disculpas por negarlos. Roberta tiene un accidente en una motocicleta. Franco le pide ayuda a Alma para alejar a Mía de Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 184
programme.desc: Simón trata de convencer a Roberta para que regrese al colegio. Lupita le dice a Mía que terminando el año escolar Miguel se regresa a Monterrey. Franco acepta que Mía y Alma sean amigas. Roberta escucha las explicaciones de Diego, pero no lo perdona.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 185
programme.desc: Gastón castiga a los alumnos por tener una mini fiesta en la habitación de los hombres. Roberta se arrepiente de haberse enamorado de Diego y planea vengarse de él. Franco le pide ayuda a Miguel para separar a Mía y Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 186
programme.desc: Pilar trata de golpear a Lupita por decirle a su mamá que ella robó los exámenes y Luján la defiende. Celina borra a Lupita de la lista de invitados al cumpleaños de Mía como venganza por decir que Pilar se robó los exámenes.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 187
programme.desc: Gastón le asegura a Mía que se vengará de Miguel. Diego le confiesa a Roberta que sigue enamorado de ella y la besa.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 188
programme.desc: Jacobo le dice a Roberta y sus amigos que no podrán seguir tocando en el café, ellos se molestan, pero saben que no pueden hacer nada. Mía encuentra una carta extraña dirigida a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 189
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta se enteran de que sus papás se encargarán de organizar su fiesta. Vico le dice a Nico que la culpa de que Lupita decidiera dejar la escuela es de Celina.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 190
programme.desc: Miguel y Mía confrontan a Celina y ella confiesa que escribió la carta influenciada por Pilar y le pide perdón a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 191
programme.desc: Diego no quiere que su papá vea la propaganda de RBD. José recibe un regalo de su tutor. Roberta entierra el vestido que usará Mía en su fiesta. Mía le dice a Alma que fingió criticar la ropa de Vico y Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 192
programme.desc: Roberta está muy preocupada porque destruyó el vestido de Mía por las razones equivocadas. Mía ocasiona que Roberta caiga y se desmaye. Diego le regala un anillo a Roberta y Miguel le regala a Mía una rosa, por su cumpleaños.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 193
programme.desc: Roberta se disculpa con Mía por haber arruinado su vestido. Alma le regala a Roberta una motocicleta. Para arruinarle el día a Mía, alguien le envía de regalo una carta de felicitación de su mamá. Alma lleva a Marcelino para que felicite a Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 194
programme.desc: Roberta y Mía festejan su cumpleaños con una gran fiesta. Pilar le explica a Enrique que planeaba arruinar la fiesta de Mía y Roberta porque no la invitaron. Franco descubre que Alma encerró a Valeria. Peter abandona a Valeria en una calle.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 195
programme.desc: Roberta acepta ser novia de Simón. Mía le agradece a Roberta que le haya regalado su vestido. Roberta le dice a Mía que se le nota que adora a Miguel. RBD canta en la fiesta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 196
programme.desc: Mía finge estar ebria y besa a Miguel. Peter renuncia antes de que lo corra Franco, por Valeria. Diego le confiesa a Tomás estar enamorado de Roberta. Gastón enfurece porque Mía termina con él. Alma le dice a Valeria que fue muy cruel con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 197
programme.desc: Gastón amenaza a Miguel con revelar su venganza en contra de Franco y Mía. Simón y Diego tienen un enfrentamiento por Roberta. Miguel le exige a Mía que le diga a Gastón que no son novios. Peter le dice a Mía que fue él quien le envió la carta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 198

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 199
programme.desc: Roberta acusa a Pilar de mentirosa. Roberta y Alma discuten por Mía. León necesita el lugar donde tocara RBD para su campaña. Gastón le dice a Mía que Miguel quiere vengarse de Franco porque cree que es responsable de la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 200
programme.desc: Diego está dispuesto a enfrentar a su papá, por Roberta y la banda. Gastón le informa a Mía que escuchó a Celina vomitando. Roberta decide quedarse con Simón y no perdonar a Diego. Franco le regala a Miguel una casa para su familia y un cheque.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 201
programme.desc: Mía trata de convencer a Celina de buscar ayuda para superar el problema de la bulimia. Los alumnos hacen un motín para que Madariaga les explique el por qué se va a ir del colegio. Miguel confía en que Franco no crea en lo que le diga Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 202
programme.desc: Madariaga les miente a los alumnos para que no pierdan el año escolar. León le dice a Gandía que en el colegio existe una banda llamada RBD y exige saber quiénes son los integrantes. Diego hará lo que sea para que Roberta descubra que Simón la engaña.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 203
programme.desc: Roberta cree que Diego inventó que Simón es casado y que delatará a RBD con Gandía. Madariaga prefiere que sus alumnos estén enojados que tristes por él. Alma ve a Simón con su hijo. Gastón le entrega a Mía un sobre con información de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 204
programme.desc: Gandía advierte a los alumnos que los integrantes de RBD serán expulsados del colegio. Franco le dice a Mía que fue Carlo quien provocó que quedará en la ruina y muriera el papá de Miguel. Franco acepta que Gastón proteja a Mía de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 205
programme.desc: Franco le dice a Carlo que pagará por estafar al papá de Miguel y es detenido. Franco abofetea a Miguel y le recrimina que haya traicionado su confianza. Gastón le dice a Miguel que su papá no murió en un accidente, sino que se suicidó por cobarde.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 206
programme.desc: Miguel decide regresar a Monterrey para investigar sobre la muerte de su papá, pero los chicos de la banda impiden que se vaya. Alma le afirma a Valeria que está interesada en Franco. Pilar cree que su papá tiene una relación con Alicia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 207
programme.desc: Alma no puede comprobar que Valeria odia a Mía y Franco se enfurece por hablar mal de ella. Franco le dice a Mía que se casará con Valeria. Gastón humilla y golpea a Miguel y Roberta lo defiende. Los alumnos se quejan de que les robaron sus cosas.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 208
programme.desc: Monserrat le pide a Roberta que deje a Simón por el bien de su bebé. Valeria insulta a Mía y Alma, provocando la furia de Alma, por lo que Franco interviene. Roberta le reclama a Gastón que por su culpa, José se fue.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 209
programme.desc: Elena le platica a Miguel que su papá sabía que sus negocios eran riesgosos y podría irse a la quiebra, sufrió fuertes depresiones y se suicidó. Peter le pide a Mía que acompañe a su papá en la boda. Elena apoya a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 210
programme.desc: Ante el Juez, Valeria le dice a Franco que no se casará con él porque sólo quería humillarlo. Miguel decide quedarse. Nico le pregunta a Lupita si se casaría con él. RBD da un concierto en el Palacio de los Deportes.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 211
programme.desc: Nico y Lupita están decididos a casarse. José descubre que Gastón informó a León sobre el concierto de RBD. Mía accede a tenderle una trampa a Gastón. Pascual les exige a los alumnos que renuncien al grupo o serán expulsados.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 212
programme.desc: Mabel amenaza a León con perjudicarlo políticamente si no permite que Diego continúe en la escuela. El padre de Nico le expresa su apoyo incondicional. Mía lleva a cabo la trampa para Gastón. Roberta y Lupita se reconcilian. Gastón ataca a Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 213
programme.desc: Miguel se pelea a golpes con Gastón por defender a Mía. Diego interroga a Roberta sobre la relación con Simón. Mía le pregunta a Miguel si es posible que vuelvan a estar juntos. Todos los alumnos celebran la boda simbólica de Lupita y Nico.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 214
programme.desc: Diego le pide a Roberta que sean amigos. Mía y Miguel se disculpan mutuamente. Mayra y Yuli quieren convencer a Nico y Lupita de que no abandonen la escuela. Mía le ofrece a Roberta unirse a sus planes de viaje. Diego encuentra a sus padres discutiendo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 215
programme.desc: Los alumnos rinden homenaje al profesor Madariaga. Mendiola exige a Pascual la reincorporación de Gastón. Madariaga le propone matrimonio a Renata. Alma y Franco se encuentran en el spa. Roberta cambia el viaje de Mía para que pueda estar con Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 216
programme.desc: Los chicos se divierten en Cuernavaca antes de que comiencen las clases. Mía y Miguel pasan sus vacaciones juntos y se enteran de que han ganado un viaje. Tras despedirse de Nico en el aeropuerto, Lupita visita a su padre para conocer a su media hermana.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 217
programme.desc: Lola rechaza a Lupita. Diego es picado por una araña gracias a Roberta que está decidida a arruinarle el día. Lupita se entera de que Dulce es también su media hermana. Mía y Miguel se van de viaje sin avisar a nadie. Llegan nuevos alumnos a la escuela.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 218
programme.desc: Mía hizo arreglos para tener habitaciones separadas en el viaje. Roberta le cuenta a Diego que terminó la relación con Simón. Giovanni se entera de que sus padres sufrieron un desfalco y quedaron en la ruina. Diego encuentra a León con otra mujer.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 219
programme.desc: Mendiola exige a Pascual que haga una maestría o renuncie. Mía habla con Franco y le dice que no se preocupe y que confíe en ella. Roberta convoca una protesta para resolver el desacuerdo con los cuartos, pero Pascual y Gastón tratarán de impedirlo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 220
programme.desc: Giovanni se queda en casa de Vico, pero su madre lo encuentra y le permite quedarse a cambio de esclavizarlo. Pascual descubre a través de las cámaras los planes de Roberta, esto hace que las sospechas del delator giren en torno a Pilar.

programme.desc: La profesora Hilda les informa a los alumnos que Hilario murió el mismo día que se casaron. Vico encuentra a Giovanni en la recámara de Florencia, su mamá. Miguel intenta seducir a Mía, pero lo rechaza.

programme.desc: Miguel le da una sorpresa a Mía y la lleva a una playa encantada lejos de todos para poder pasar tiempo a solas. Giovanni le presume a Tomás que la mamá de Vico quiso seducirlo. Mía y Miguel llegan a una isla, pero pierden su lancha.

programme.title: The Egyptians

programme.desc: The arrival of menacing German U-Boats in international waters rewrote the rulebook on maritime conflict, and so Britain began rapidly converting its merchant vessels into battleships. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. programme.title: A Haunting

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: The White Cliffs of Dover long signaled Britain's frontier. By the first millennium, the land was a patchwork of rival kingdoms. The Norman conquest of 1066 changed everything, ushering in an age of castles and fortresses that asserted both power and protection. These enduring monuments testify to centuries of conquest and the long forging of four nations under one flag.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: In Saqqara desert, south of Cairo, stands a little-known monument whose walls are covered with exceptional texts: the pyramid of Pepi II - Egypt's longest reigning pharaoh. Its funerary chambers house the oldest collection of religious texts in the world! Experts are now able to scan the structure in the hope to solve its many enigmas.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: For years, Egyptologists sought Cleopatra's tomb, a treasure yet undiscovered. But a recent find offers hope-a mummified hand, claimed to be hers, surfaced in an American collector's possession. International experts join forces, tracing the relic's journey from excavation sites to DNA labs. Through exclusive investigation, the film aims to unveil the 2,000-year-old mystery of Cleopatra.

programme.title: George III: The Genius of the Mad King
programme.desc: After 200 years under lock and key, all the personal papers of one of our most important monarchs are seeing the light of day for the first time. In the first documentary to gain extensive access to the Royal Archives, Robert Hardman sheds fascinating new light on George III, Britain's longest-reigning king.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: In Ithaca, Queen Penelope endures the presence of Suitors who covet her hand, and the throne of her husband Odysseus - who disappeared more than 10 years ago.

programme.title: Works of Art Stolen by The Nazis
programme.desc: The film examines the mechanisms of Nazi extortion during the Second World War, and is interspersed with current issues surrounding restitutions. It retraces the incredible stories of 3 major works having belonged to Jewish collectors, from their plundering by the Nazis though to their final restitution.

programme.title: Great Native American Warrior Chiefs
programme.desc: From age to age, across the lands, Native Americans have made their mark in history. Take a closer look at Native American stories that will be told for generations. Learn about Chief Big Foot, Sitting Bull, Cochise, Black Hawk, Chief Joseph and more.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette: The Trial of a Queen
programme.desc: On the night of August 2, 1793, Marie Antoinette is transferred to the Conciergerie. Her husband has been sent to the guillotine, her children have been taken away, all the other European monarchies have abandoned her and France is calling for her head. She was judged as a queen, her tragic death made her immortal. Thanks to secret documents freshly decoded this film grasps her last days.

programme.title: The Ace's War
programme.desc: At the dawn of the 20th Century, the future of aviation is in the hands of a few visionaries and daredevils. In 1903 American brothers Wilbur and Orville Wright make four flights of a few dozen meters on a North Carolina beach. The age of the pioneers ends suddenly in 1914 with the outbreak of the First World War.

programme.title: Princess Alice: The Queen's Mother-In-Law
programme.desc: Featuring exclusive interviews and archived footage, this film sheds new light on one of the royal family's most unknown personalities. Princess Alice, a great granddaughter of Queen Victoria, married into the Greek royal family before their monarchy was overthrown by revolution. She was later placed in mental hospitals and subjected to experiments by psychiatrists such as Sigmund Freud himself.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Letters: A Monarch Unveiled
programme.desc: As AN Wilson explores Queen Victoria's complex relationship with her mother, he discovers the Queen Mother may not have been as cold towards her daughter as commonly perceived.

programme.title: Life in the Time of
programme.desc: Take a dive into ancient Rome, where gladiatorial fights took place regularly. As of the 3rd century BC, these were highlights in the life of the city. In the amphitheatres, the crowd thronged to see professional fighters, free or slaves, sometimes to the death. Schools dedicated to learning the art of combat were throughout the Empire, those of Aquileia and Capua being among the most famous.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Perseus was not meant to come into the world. Fearing the fulfilment of the prediction according to which his grandson would kill him, King Acrisius shut his daughter Danaë away in a fortified tower.

programme.title: Inside The Tower of London: Crimes, Conspiracies, Confessions
programme.desc: The Princess in the Tower, who lost their lives in mysterious circumstances; evil Judge Jeffries and how he came to regret his actions, and the larger than life Colonel Blood, who remains the only person to steal the Crown Jewels, and how he got away with it; also the story of the last man to be executed there.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Theseus was the fruit of dual paternity: Aegeus King of Athens slept with Aethra when she had just been raped by Poseidon, God of the Sea. Theseus, who grew into a strong, brave young man, therefore had a double lineage - both divine and royal. But Theseus' great courage did not stop him from neglecting his duties. Carried along by his victory, he committed a few irreversible oversights.

programme.title: Thunder Run on Baghdad
programme.desc: The Iraqis wait, divided between hope and fear. Members of the military attempt to save face, knowing that their equipment, which dates at best from the early 1970s, will not weigh heavily against the five hundred armored tanks and seventy thousand men who are equipped with the very latest technology.

programme.title: Castles & Palaces of Europe
programme.desc: Our journey starts with Hohenzollern Castle, the cradle of the last Prussian reigning family and a symbol of their power: an eagle's nest, perched on a green peak. After a trip to a snail farm, a culinary speciality of Swabia, we discover Ludwigsburg Castle, a small pleasure pavilion that gradually became one of Europe's largest baroque residences.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: Thetis asks Hephaestus, the god of blacksmiths to forge new armour and weapons for her son Achilles. At dawn, she hands them to him, knowing that they will lead to his death.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Food not only mirrors society, it shapes landscapes, coloring fields and vineyards through the centuries. From wheat in France to rye in Germany, from wine to beer, clichés blur when history is traced. Flying above both lands, we uncover shifting 'food borders' born of shared heritage, revealing how culture and geography intertwined to craft their culinary identities.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: The Boer War: 1899-1902
programme.desc: Journey back in time to a different age, when the sun never set on the British Empire and her armies were great in number. The Boer War: 1899-1902 was a turning point in British military history and would revolutionize tactics, battlefield strategy, equipment, and training. Well known participants in the Boar Wars include: Harry 'Breaker' Morant, Winston Churchill and Mahatma Gandhi.

programme.title: Megapolis: The Ancient World Revealed
programme.desc: In the 4th century BC, Alexander the Great envisioned Alexandria, a humble fishing village, as a cosmopolitan megacity. Its strategic location made it a thriving hub, hosting up to 1 million people. Witness its revolutionary urban design and iconic structures like the Great Library and the Lighthouse.

programme.title: U-455: The Mystery of the Lost Submarine
programme.desc: In Summer 2008, a mysterious submarine, German U-boat U-455 is discovered off the coast of Italy at 120 meters deep. For Lorenzo del Veneziano, an underwater marine archeologist, it's an amazing sight. The U-boat is intact! It stands almost vertically at the bottom of the sea, it's hull stuck in the sediment. What is the story of this ship?

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Taking revenge against Prometheus, Zeus created the first woman - the beautiful Pandora. He gave her a manipulative and deceptive character, and subjected Prometheus to terrible torture. But although Zeus and Prometheus both shared a shrewd and cunning nature, they clashed fiercely. Prometheus wanted to be of help to mankind, and managed to convince Zeus to give them fire.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Hermes was the youngest of the Gods of Olympus. Right from birth, he was an insolent, thieving, trickster God. While still a baby, he escaped from the cave in which his mother Maia gave birth to him, and stole Apollo's herd.

programme.title: Elizabeth I
programme.desc: The summer of 1586. Elizabeth I was in fear of her life. A group of Catholic extremists were planning to kill her and install her cousin, Mary, Queen of Scots, on her throne. Behind the terrorists was the might of Spain, whose forces were ready to invade were the plot to succeed. But one man stood in the way: Sir Francis Walsingham, Elizabeth's spymaster and security chief.

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: The life and loves of France's most famous king, Louis XIV. Dubbed the Sun King by his admiring court, Louis conquered half of Europe, conducted dozens of love affairs and dazzled his contemporaries with his lavish entertainments. But perhaps his greatest achievement - and certainly his longest lasting love - was the incredible palace he built at Versailles, one of the wonders of the world.

programme.title: Life in Anglo Saxon Times
programme.desc: Filmed at Houlgate Village near York, 'Life in Anglo Saxon Times' provides an introduction to known aspects of life during the Dark Ages. Simply presented, but with authority, this film features authentic, atmospheric reconstructions of everyday life, expert commentary and covers laws and religion, the Anglo Saxon Chronicle and Alfred the Great.

programme.title: The Viking Myths
programme.desc: Calamities upon catastrophes befall Midgard, endless wars and three years of eternal winter... the signs are unmistakable. Ragnarök is here. The great confrontation between the gods and the forces of darkness is at hand. At the foot of Bifrost, Heimdall warns the gods by blowing his trumpet, but it is too late. Odin consults the head of Mímir, who tells him that the hour has come. The war rages on.

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: Harland and Wolff weathered a difficult post-war period of internal turmoil and global depression. But as the world crept towards a second global conflict, renewed demand revitalized the shipbuilder's fortunes. The British Navy required an imposing fleet, as Germany's Scharnhorst and Gneisenau patrolled the seas. But the advent of the aerial age consigned ships to a subservient role.

programme.title: The True Christian History of America
programme.desc: The True Christian History of America is a powerful documentary, showing the Bible-based Christian origins of the early American view of freedom. This film traces the principles of liberty back to England and the great Reformation. You will see interviews with experts from around the world, who relate how champions of the Gospel pursued the cause of freedom across the centuries.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Since the dawn of the new millennium predictions of the apocalypse have reached a fever pitch. Some scholars believe the Bible tells us there will be a mysterious event called 'The Rapture'. Many believe in the 'second coming' of Christ. Will there be a 'third' coming as well? Could there be a formula hidden in the Book of Revelation? The answers are at once hopeful and frightening.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. What are archaeologists, paleontologists, biologists and theologians saying today? Is the story fact or fiction? The evidence may shock you. Where was the Garden of Eden? What was it like? Does it still exist, if indeed it ever did? Explore the evidence and journey back to the original birthplace of man.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: The legendary Holy Grail, believed to be a relic of the Last Supper of Christ, has eluded searchers for 2,000 years and the quest continues today. Or has it actually been found as some claim and are its legendary powers real? Will scientists ever decipher the Copper Scroll found near the Dead Sea and learn the way to a 2,000 year old treasure?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Two of the world's great religions, Christianity and Judaism, base many of their most important beliefs on declarations made to Moses atop Mt. Sinai. Are the miraculous stories attributed to Moses factual? Did Moses receive the Ten Commandments from God?

Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!
